The best plan rescues four of the five people and defers the adult at Syaphru temple, for a total cost of 154. Carrying all five in one loop is impossible with 4 seats, and rescuing everyone needs two loops (190 minutes of driving). Deferring the adult (penalty 20) is cheaper than either of those.

<plan>
drive car1 myagang-shelter uttargaya-school
load car1 child 2
drive car1 uttargaya-school nilkantha-market
drive car1 nilkantha-market syaphru-temple
load car1 elderly 2
drive car1 syaphru-temple nilkantha-market
drive car1 nilkantha-market uttargaya-school
drive car1 uttargaya-school myagang-shelter
unload car1 child 2
unload car1 elderly 2
defer syaphru-temple adult 1
</plan>
COST: 154
